intent: Prevent concurrent installer rollback from clobbering client state for mcp-bpmn-33g.10.12.
applied_fixes: Distinguish confirmed-missing from unreadable client registration state during rollback.
Preserve registrations deleted or replaced after the transaction added them.
Reject Codex registration snapshots that codex mcp add cannot reproduce exactly.
Verify new Codex and Claude registrations before commit.
Canonicalize per-prefix locks and release them despite cleanup failures.
Record installed clients and reject diagrams-path changes that cannot update every recorded client.
advisory: A third-party mutation strictly between an exact comparison and the following client CLI remove remains outside the clients' available compare-and-swap capabilities.
SIGKILL or host failure can leave a stale lock that requires the actionable manual recovery printed by the installer.
Cross-filesystem artifact snapshot moves predate this selected bead and were excluded from its review scope.
